```{r}
library(arrow)

yellow_2021 = read_parquet("yellow_tripdata_2022-01.parquet")

names(yellow_2021)
```
```{r}
summary(yellow_2021$PULocationID)
table(yellow_2021$PULocationID)

yellow_2021$pul = as.factor(yellow_2021$PULocationID)
yellow_2021$dol = as.factor(yellow_2021$DOLocationID)
mod1 = lm(tip_amount ~ pul+dol, data = yellow_2021[yellow_2021$payment_type==1, ])
summary(mod1)
```
